description:
You are a network security analyst reviewing web traffic from a workstation flagged by your IDS. A packet capture is available at /home/ga/Documents/captures/http.cap. Reconstruct the complete HTTP browsing session and produce an analysis report at /home/ga/Documents/captures/http_analysis_report.txt containing:

1. All HTTP request URIs (the full path for each GET or POST request)
2. The IP address of the web server contacted
3. All HTTP response status codes observed (e.g., 200, 302, 404)
4. The User-Agent string identifying the client browser
5. The total number of HTTP request packets in the capture

Each section should be clearly labeled. List all URIs and status codes individually.

Login credentials: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
